title: Publish release 2.74.0 through the sanctioned script
action: Run `scripts/release.sh 2.74.0` with BEE_DISPATCH_ID set to an authorized deployment dispatch and the CI-pinned opencode-ai 1.18.16 (/tmp/oc11816/node_modules/.bin) first on PATH, as the 2.68.0 re-run did. The script bumps both plugin manifests, runs the regen chain (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write), runs the declared test suite before tagging, makes the release commit, tags v2.74.0, pushes main and the tag, waits for the release-binaries workflow and verifies the published assets. Never walk those steps by hand. Re-running at a version already committed is idempotent — it resumes the tail. The regen obligation on .claude-plugin/plugin.json is discharged INSIDE the script's own regen chain, which is why the release manifest rides this cell's files.

prohibitions: Do not hand-walk bump, tag or push
